If the @FBI were truly working for the American people, they wouldn’t be briefing you, Lauren. They’d be cuffing you. They’d be dragging you out of whatever tax-funded fascist cosplay you’re playing dress-up in and marching you right into a federal courtroom for lying to the public, misusing your office, and pushing a war on marginalized people like it’s your birthright. If the FBI really gave a damn about the Constitution you constantly wave around but clearly haven’t read, they’d charge you under every statute that covers fraud, abuse of power, and willful public endangerment.

But no—here you are, grinning like you just finished auditioning for “MAGA Barbie: Domestic Terror Edition,” proud of a briefing from Dan Bongino, a man who went from failed Secret Service agent to full-time conspiracy carnival barker. This isn’t law enforcement. This is state-sanctioned propaganda. You're not celebrating justice; you're cheering that the boot is finally stomping the people you don't like. And let’s be honest: the only reason you're clapping is because you're not the one being investigated—for now.

You parade around like some pocket-sized patriot while using your platform to lie about healthcare, demonize children, and incite violence with every dishonest, bile-spewing word you say. You cry “groomer” while cozying up to convicted predators and abusers in your own party. You scream “protect the children” while voting against programs that would actually feed, clothe, and educate them. You don’t care about children—you care about control.

You invoke “radical trans surgeries” like it’s a plague descending from the heavens, yet you’ve never read a medical report, spoken to a trans youth, or shown the slightest inkling of empathy. You weaponize fear and ignorance to whip your base into a frenzy, and then act shocked when someone gets hurt. You're not a protector. You're the arsonist screaming about smoke while you're still holding the gas can.

The truth is, you’re not happy the FBI is working for the people—you’re thrilled that it’s no longer holding you accountable. That’s the whole game, right? Undermine faith in institutions until they serve only you and your corporate donors. You don’t want justice; you want immunity. You don’t want freedom; you want control. And you’ll burn the truth to the ground if it means you can sit on the ashes with your fake Bible in one hand and a check from your next gun lobby donor in the other.

You call yourself a representative of the people, but the only people you serve are those who can afford to exploit others. You want to criminalize healthcare, silence science, erase LGBTQ+ lives, and then cry “persecution” when you’re met with resistance. You’ve built your whole identity around being the loudest, dumbest person in the room—and somehow you’re still surprised when the room laughs at you.

So no, Lauren. You’re not here because the FBI is doing its job. You’re here because you’re part of the rot. And if we had a justice system with even a fraction of the spine you pretend to have, you’d be sitting in a cell reading the Constitution you helped shred.

You’re not a patriot. You’re a parasite.

And the sooner we’re rid of your performative fascism, the better off this country will be.
